# `dry check`

Check a toolpath against machine capabilities for physical limits and boundaries

## Help

```text
Check a toolpath against machine capabilities for physical limits and boundaries

Usage: dry check [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>

Options:
      --max-x <MAX_X>                      Maximum machine X travel (mm) [default: 300]
      --max-y <MAX_Y>                      Maximum machine Y travel (mm) [default: 300]
      --max-z <MAX_Z>                      Maximum machine Z travel (mm) [default: 300]
      --max-feedrate <MAX_FEEDRATE>        Maximum machine feedrate (mm/min)
      --max-spindle-rpm <MAX_SPINDLE_RPM>  Maximum spindle speed (RPM)
      --json                               Print report as JSON
  -h, --help                               Print help
```
